chunks.text: MGI has received approximately 400 international CVs. Our international applicant network supports role-specific sourcing and assessment before candidates are shortlisted.

chunks.title: Talent Screening Process | MGI
chunks.heading: 1. Requirements first
chunks.text: We define the role, schedule, language expectations, relevant tools, customer interaction and performance criteria.

chunks.title: Talent Screening Process | MGI
chunks.heading: 2. CV and experience review
chunks.text: Applications are compared with the role scorecard, focusing on relevant experience, work history and task fit. A strong CV alone does not establish suitability.

chunks.title: Talent Screening Process | MGI
chunks.heading: 3. Skills and communication assessment
chunks.text: Where appropriate, shortlisted candidates may complete interviews, communication checks, work samples and client-specific practical assessments.

chunks.title: Talent Screening Process | MGI
chunks.heading: 4. Client review and selection
chunks.text: Candidate profiles are shared only with appropriate consent and with personal information handled responsibly. Clients can review shortlisted candidates before final selection.

chunks.title: Talent Screening Process | MGI
chunks.heading: 5. Onboarding and quality review
chunks.text: Approved candidates receive role-specific onboarding, process instructions and performance expectations as defined by the client engagement. Important: Our approximately 400 received CVs form an applicant pipeline; candidate assessment and availability are confirmed for each engagement.
